name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: TestServer and GetRemoteUsers now give Plex-aware messaging (routed through IExternalCatalogProvider.TestConnectionAsync) instead of a generic 'failed to connect'/'no federation token' when the configured server is a pasted-token Plex source, not a Jellyfin friend. PlexCatalogProvider gained GetAllLibrariesAsync, an unfiltered sibling of GetLibrariesAsync that will back an upcoming library-visibility picker - it needs to offer the currently-disallowed sections too, or a library declined once could never be re-allowed. This version also fixes a build-breaking regression picked up mid-development: a botched edit had deleted the try/using block backing GetRemoteUsers' user list fetch (leaving its own success path referencing an undeclared variable) and dropped the #region Server Management opener paired with an #endregion later in the file, so the whole plugin failed to compile. Both are restored; 301 tests, all green.
